🥳💫 The harvest celebration begins at the FRIDAY NIGHT STREET PARTY! 🎉💿

We are taking it back to the festival’s roots for the 25th anniversary and throwing a party on Paonia’s Grand Avenue, just like very first fest.

📆 Friday, September 25th, 2026
⏰ 5pm - late night! 
📍 Paonia Creative District

And just like the very first fest, you’ll enjoy live music, art gallery openings, local food, and the sweetest little street party you’ve ever seen. 🤩 

Kick it off with the costume bike parade (theme: heroes and villains🧝‍♀️🦹) led by a live DJ from Paonia Town Park! 🎧 🚲 

🍷🍔 Grab some local, beer, wine, or cider from the Drink Local tent, and come hungry for local eats throughout the Creative District.

Ap Catering & Destinations 
cow.folk at Lore Cacao 
good love 
Hungry Bird Pizza at Paonia United Brewing Co 
Paco's Tacos 🌮 
Rio Bravo
Stealys 
Sweetgrass Paonia 
The Learning Council 

Stick around once the sun goes down for the 🍻 PUB CRAWL 🎸 where you’ll discover even more local music, dance parties, and quirky watering holes.

🚌🌕 While you’re at it, take the free shuttle bus over to Big B's Delicious Orchards for dancing in an orchard under the harvest moon.

Come celebrate, community, creativity, and everything that makes the North Fork Valley special with us! 🪕✨

🪕💃🏽 Learn to contra dance at Harvest Fest! 🕺🎻 

Contra dance may be new to MHF, but it’s not new to Colorado’s Western Slope! This tradition dates back to the early anglo-settlers who arrived in the valley around the turn of the century. Contra dance has been a popular pastime and place for community connection ever since. 

📆 Saturday, September 26th
⏰ 3 pm
📍 Paonia Town Park

Contra is a partner-style dance where dancers form long, parallel lines, and dance in groups of four with interchanging couples. A ‘”caller” instructs the steps while a live band plays up-beat traditional folk music. 

📣 No experience needed!
📣 A caller will tell you exactly what to do!
📣 Bring a partner or meet one there!

We can’t wait to welcome hardpressedband and caller Andrea Earley Coen to the stage to keep this tradition alive and thriving at Mountain Harvest Fest! 🎶⛰️🌶️
